svg.text: Real data: Ensembl REST API / 1000 Genomes phase 3 · 19 SNPs × 10 populations · % carrying the highlighted allele
No Filipino sample exists in 1000 Genomes — KHV (Vietnamese) & CDX (Dai) are the nearest proxies (two leftmost columns).
